allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 9 m up its host at 8 years and 14 m at 15. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: mid-green leaves, purple grapes.

appearance.organs.fruit.note: Its bunch drawn berry by berry (spec rework L1c), its kind from its characters, by the rule at the flowering plants: 6 branches of 5 berries, by eye (no source gives a count), each berry about 8.5 mm across (Trees and Shrubs Online: 1/3 in), hanging from its node as before. From floras and extension pages as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read.

appearance.organs.fruit.inflorescence.ki.note: How PlantGen lays out an inflorescence, a choice of the model's (spec rework L1): the inflorescence characters set the cluster of any look a taxon draws as one (`"inflorescence": {}`), its kind, how many units it bears on each axis, its primary branches and how it holds itself. Sizes, stalks and spacing stay set by hand until programs size their organs from characters.

appearance.organs.fruit.shape.kind.note: How PlantGen lays out an inflorescence, a choice of the model's (spec rework L1): the inflorescence characters set the cluster of any look a taxon draws as one (`"inflorescence": {}`), its kind, how many units it bears on each axis, its primary branches and how it holds itself. Sizes, stalks and spacing stay set by hand until programs size their organs from characters.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a deciduous woody vine of streams and woodland in California and southern Oregon that climbs by tendrils into the crowns of oaks and willows and drapes over them in curtains of broad, heart-shaped, shallowly lobed leaves, turning red in autumn, with small purple grapes. Not fitted to measurements.

generator.params.dioecious.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): the sexual system its taxa state most often decides; a species whose taxa state dioecy no more often than another system bears both sexes on every plant until it states its own.

generator.params.divergence.note: What the words mean, as accounts of phyllotaxis such as Okabe and colleagues' use them: a spiral or two-ranked shoot bears one leaf at a node, a decussate one a pair and a whorled one three or more. A spiral turns about the golden angle (137.5 degrees) from node to node and two ranks half a turn; pairs and whorls alternate, each standing over the gaps of the one below, half the gap between its own leaves round (90 degrees for pairs). Three ranks turn a third of a turn, as their name says.

generator.params.sex.note: How PlantGen draws the sexes, a choice of the model's (dioecy, 2026-10-14): a plant's sex is its own draw, dealt across a package's seeds so that both sexes grow; the typical plant (sex 0.5) is female, so it shows its fruit.

generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the climber base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the climber program gave as defaults until then.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

host.note: The host the spec's authors chose for this guest, grown at the age, environment and seed given.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (plant forms milestone F7). Calibration against measurements and photographs comes later.
